verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), but a markdown rendition of the docs is served at /docs.md (HTTP 200). That gives agents a machine-readable entry point, though only one such page is evidenced. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, documented agent-oriented or markdown docs coverage beyond a single page, an OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
